title: 第3章 一根骨头？
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
很快，一道道光芒再次闪烁。

    无一例外，觉醒的都是白色器具卡，有人觉醒了镰刀，有人觉醒了剪刀，还有人觉醒了石锤。

    在这边陲小城，这些都算是不错的本命卡。

    觉醒卡片后回家修炼一段时间，就能成为一星卡徒，开辟出卡槽空间，从而可以使用一张副卡。

    若是能得到一张不错的副卡，实用性往往比本命卡还要强。

    “儿子，别紧张，爹相信你肯定能觉醒好卡。”林峰的声音从旁边传来，带着几分安慰。

    林奇深吸一口气，强装镇定。

    “紧张？我林奇就不知道紧张为何物！”

    “儿子，你牵错人了，爹在这边。”

    林奇僵硬的转过头，发现自己握住的竟然是一个不认识的大叔，那个大叔也一脸笑意的看着他。

    饶是脸皮再厚，林奇一时间也尴尬的只想钻到地缝里。

    “出了，出了！”

    就在这时，前方突然传来一阵嘈杂的惊呼声。

    “是绿色的！有人觉醒了绿色本命卡！”

    林奇和林峰立刻抬头望去，只见觉醒台上，一个穿着粉色裙子的少女正激动地捧着一张泛着绿光的卡牌，脸上满是难以置信的笑容。

    林奇连忙双手合十，小声祈祷。

    “源卡之神保佑，既然给了我林奇一次新生，那多少给点福利啊，我不要紫卡，给张蓝卡或者绿卡也行啊！”

    可接下来的觉醒，却再次让众人失望。

    除了那个少女的绿色卡，其余人觉醒的不是白色卡，就是无色卡。

    无色本命卡也被称作废卡。

    往往都是一颗石子，一朵花，一根树枝之类的东西。这些卡没有任何特殊能力，也没有晋升空间，几乎毫无用处。

    看着那些觉醒了废卡的人垂头丧气的模样，林奇的心跳越来越快。

    终于，轮到他了。

    他刚走上台，台下就传来一阵议论声。

    “这不是林奇吗？咱们石铁城的天才少年！”

    “还真是！”

    “传闻林奇几个月就会走路，一岁就可以流畅说话，是神眷之人啊！”

    “他应该能觉醒绿色资质的本命卡吧？”
content_en:
Soon, rays of light flashed again.

Without exception, all white equipment cards were awakened. Some people awakened sickles, some people awakened scissors, and some people awakened stone hammers.

In this small border town, these are considered good natal cards.

After awakening the card, you can go home and practice for a period of time, and you will become a one-star card disciple, which will open up a card slot space, so that you can use a secondary card.

If you can get a good secondary card, it is often more practical than the natal card.

"Son, don't be nervous. Dad believes that you will be able to awaken the card." Lin Feng's voice came from the side, with a bit of comfort.

Lin Qi took a deep breath and pretended to be calm.

"Nervous? I, Lynch, don't know what nervousness is!"

"Son, you got the wrong person. Dad is here."

Lin Qi turned his head stiffly and found that the person he was holding was an unknown uncle. The uncle also looked at him with a smile on his face.

No matter how thick-skinned he was, Lin Qi was so embarrassed that he just wanted to crawl into the cracks of the ground.

"It's out, it's out!"

At this moment, a loud exclamation suddenly came from the front.

"It's green! Someone has awakened the green natal card!"

Lin Qi and Lin Feng immediately looked up and saw a girl in a pink skirt on the awakening stage excitedly holding a card glowing with green light, with an incredible smile on her face.

Lynch quickly clasped his hands together and prayed quietly.

"The God of Source Cards bless you. Since you have given me Lynch a new life, how about some benefits? I don't want a purple card, so I can give you a blue or green card!"

But the next awakening disappointed everyone again.

Except for the girl's green card, the others awakened either white cards or colorless cards.

Colorless natal cards are also called waste cards.

It's usually something like a stone, a flower, or a branch.These cards have no special abilities, no room for promotion, and are almost useless.

Seeing the dejected looks of those who had awakened the waste cards, Lynch's heart beat faster and faster.

Finally, it was his turn.

As soon as he stepped onto the stage, there was a burst of discussion from the audience.

"Isn't this Lin Qi? Our talented boy from Shitiecheng!"

"It's true!"

"It is said that Lynch can walk in a few months and can speak fluently at the age of one. He is a person favored by God!"

"He should be able to awaken the green qualification natal card, right?"
